description: Move right in and enjoy this light, bright, beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home featuring modern finishes throughout. Recent updates include carpet, linoleum, interior and exterior paint, kitchen cabinets, bathroom cabinets, appliances and window blinds. Set on a spacious lot with room for your RV, toys, or extra storage, this affordable home offers both charm and convenience. It is centrally located near public transit and freeway access, right across from the community gardens.
